title: Your saved searches
description: Catalog searches you have saved, with the filters that were active.

help.title: About saved searches
help.overview: Searches your customers saved in your shop, under a name, to run them again. A saved search only remembers the filters; it changes nothing in your catalog.

sections.title: Each search
items: It keeps the categories, collection, price range and sort the customer chose.
Running it again shows the catalog as it is now, not as it was when saved.
Here you see every customer's saved searches, and a new one asks whose it is. On a customer, you see only theirs.

catalogDescription: Every catalog search saved by a customer.
